Smt. Nigar Fatima vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... 
on 24 July, 2024 
Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:50032
Court No. - 4
Case :- Writ - A No. - 5477 of 2024
Petitioner :- Smt. Nigar Fatima
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administrat
Counsel for Petitioner :- Karm Veer Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1. Heard.
2.  This Court has passed the order dated 22.7.2024 which reads as under:
"1. Heard Shri Karm Veer Yadav, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri Sandeep Sharma, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has assailed the impugned transfer order dated 30.6.2024 passed by the opposite party no.2, i.e., Commissioner, Food Safety and Smt. Nigar Fatima vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 24 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122606319/
1 Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow, whereby the petitioner, who is serving on the post of Junior Analyst (Food), has been transferred from Lucknow to Gorakhpur in public interest.
3. Shri Yadav has stated that the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow has preferred a letter dated 12.7.2023 (annexure-2)
issuing to the concerned authorities seeking option from the employees for transferring them in 12 new Divisional Food Safety and Drug Labs which are situated at Saharanpur, Moradabad, Bareilly, Aligarh, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Chitrakootdham Mandal, Ayodhya, Basti, Devi Patan Mandal, Vindhyachal and Azamgarh. Pursuant to the aforesaid letter, the petitioner had given her option for three places namely,
Prayagraj, Kanpur and Ayodhya (annexure-3) but by means of the impugned order,
she has been transferred to Gorakhpur, the place which has not been indicated in the aforesaid letter dated 12.7.2023. 
4. Shri Sharma, on the basis of instructions, has stated that since the petitioner has completed her six years of service at Lucknow, therefore, she has been transferred to Gorakhpur in public interest but on the letter dated 12.7.2023 (annexure-2) and the options given by the petitioner (annexure-3) , he has requested that some short time may be given to seek instructions. 
5. List/put up this matter on 24.07.2024 as fresh to enable the learned Standing Counsel to seek complete written instructions in the matter.
6. This matter may be taken up immediately after fresh cases." 
3. Shri Tushar Verma, learned Additional C.S.C. has produced the instructions letter dated 22.7.2024 preferred by the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow addressing to the C.S.C., the same is taken on record. 
4. Shri Verma has drawn attention of this Court towards Annexure-2 which is a letter dated 12.7.2023 being issued seeking option from employees to be posted at a particular place. In the aforesaid letter dated 12.7.2023, it has been categorically indicated that presently, only six regional labs are functional and construction work of 12 labs is under progress. The option so given by the petitioner is Prayagraj, Kanpur and Ayodhya where the construction work of lab has not been completed and work is still under progress. 
5. Shri Verma has stated that as per aforesaid instructions, presently, six food labs are functional in the State of U.P. namely, (1) Lucknow, (2) Gorakhpur, (3) Varanasi,(4) Meerut, (5) Agra and (6)
Jhansi , therefore, the petitioner has been transferred at Gorakhpur where the lab is functional considering the fact that the petitioner should be transferred at such place where any work can be taken form her. He has further stated that the petitioner has completed six years of her service at the present place of posting. 
Smt. Nigar Fatima vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 24 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122606319/
2 6. Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated that since the option has been taken from the petitioner, therefore, such option may be considered. 
7. On that, learned Additional C.S.C. has stated that if the construction work of the labs for twelve new labs is completed and the petitioner represents for that, any appropriate decision may be taken at that point of time but presently, she may not be posted at any place where the labs are not functional. 
8. Having considered the arguments of the learned counsel for the parties, the instructions letter so provided by the competent authority and without entering into merits of the issue,this writ petition is disposed of finally at the admission stage giving liberty to the petitioner to prefer a fresh representation to the competent authority at appropriate stage when the construction work at Prayagraj or Kanpur or Ayodhya are completed and if it would be feasible at that point of time to accommodate the petitioner at that places, an appropriate order may be passed by the competent authority but presently, the petitioner should submit her joining at the transferred place.
9. It is made clear that the petitioner may prefer a representation after submitting her joining at the transferred place in terms of the judgement of the Hon'ble Apex Court in re: S.C. Saxena Vs. Union of India and others reported in (2006) 9 SCC 583 and if such representation is preferred by the petitioner, the same shall be considered and disposed of strictly, by speaking and reasoned order in accordance with law after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, if it is so required,
with expedition and the decision thereof shall be intimated to the petitioner forthwith.
Order Date :- 24.7.2024 Shravan [Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.]
